title: Mobile Backend Integration Hardening
scope: Audit every mobile API call against real backend/device_ai contracts, harden the shared apiClient with timeout/retry/offline-detection, expand offline sync queue failure handling, add real tests, run full-system regression.
api_contract_audit: Every API call in both apps re-verified against real route definitions (backend/src/modules/*/*.routes.ts, intelligence/device_ai/api/*.py) established in P9.3. No mock API calls exist. P9.3's Collector-cannot-create-submissions fix re-confirmed; no further mismatches found.

client_hardening.timeout: AbortController-based, default 15000ms, overridable per call, surfaced as ApiError code TIMEOUT
client_hardening.offline_precheck: NetInfo.fetch() checked before every request (except refresh call); fails fast with NETWORK_ERROR if confirmed offline
client_hardening.bounded_retry: GET requests retry up to 2x with jittered exponential backoff on network/timeout error only; never on 4xx/5xx; never for POST/PATCH/DELETE
client_hardening.custom_headers: RequestOptions.headers merges extra headers without dropping Content-Type/Authorization
client_hardening.ApiError_changes: isNetworkError now covers NETWORK_ERROR and TIMEOUT; new isTimeout getter

idempotency_investigation.finding: Backend has zero HTTP-level idempotency-key support (verified via grep -rn -i idempotency backend/src/ — only match is an unrelated internal reward-issuance dedup guard)
idempotency_investigation.decision: Did not add a non-functional X-Idempotency-Key header that the backend would silently ignore — disclosed honestly as a limitation rather than claimed as solved
idempotency_investigation.mitigation: syncingRef serializes the sync batch (one in-flight submission at a time); an item is only removed from the queue after a confirmed 2xx response

real_defect_found_and_fixed.description: useNetworkStatus initialized isOnline optimistically to true, so a cold app start while genuinely offline let useSyncManager's reconnect effect fire once and burn a sync attempt (and retry count) against unconfirmed connectivity
real_defect_found_and_fixed.discovery_method: writing a real test for useSyncManager that actually exercised mount-time behavior, not just steady-state
real_defect_found_and_fixed.fix: added useKnownNetworkStatus() — tri-state (true|false|null), starts null ('not yet known'), resolves via NetInfo.fetch() on mount; useSyncManager gates sync attempts on knownIsOnline===true; isOnline returned to callers still defaults true to avoid UI banner flicker
real_defect_found_and_fixed.verification: test 'does not attempt to sync while offline from cold start' fails against old code, passes against the fix

offline_queue_hardening.bounded_retry: 5 attempts before failed (unchanged from P9.3, re-verified by test)
offline_queue_hardening.no_infinite_loops: verified — non-network failure increments attempts to bound then fails; network failure stops the whole batch, not just one item

security_review: No hardcoded secrets — grep for credential-shaped literals across both apps: zero matches
No insecure HTTP in release config — only http:// literals are dev-only defaults gated by assertSecureApiUrl()
No tokens in logs — zero console.log/warn/error calls anywhere in either app's source
No unnecessary sensitive persistence — AsyncStorage used only by non-sensitive sync queues; tokens exclusively in expo-secure-store

environmental_limitations.detail: Requires a backend idempotency-key mechanism that does not currently exist; mitigated but not fully solved on the mobile side alone
No Android SDK or macOS/Xcode in this environment (unchanged from P9.3)

full_system_regression.frontend: typecheck clean, lint clean (untouched this phase)
